purpose: Durable, hash-pinned frozen game + saved-world bytes for the current-game AOT/PGO benchmark. Evidence must not depend on /tmp.

provenance.origin_remotes: none configured (freeze is the sole reproducibility mechanism)
provenance.provenance_kind: byte-identical frozen copy of a dirty worktree, verified against committed file manifests, not reconstructed from a git archive of the live tree

live_source_disclaimer.statement: The live worktree is NOT the workload and was not copied, in whole or in part, into these bytes.
live_source_disclaimer.note: The live worktree advanced past the freeze. Frozen bytes were validated against the committed manifests before copying; no live file was substituted.

saved_world.manifest_path_root_note: saved-world-manifest.json paths are relative to the SLOT directory, not to the world root. All entries were verified with cwd = <game-source>/worlds-v1/15f2268da8ec2a4105ef2deaf6ae0b19. The three subdirectories are snapshots of that same slot, not separate slots.

builder.tool: python3 tarfile (GNU_FORMAT) + gzip, mtime=0, sorted paths, uid/gid 0, fixed mtime 1793350920
builder.why_not_gnu_tar: bsdtar 3.5.3 on this host has no --sort/--mtime/--owner, so determinism is produced in python
builder.rebuild_recipe: python3: tarfile.open(...,'w', GNU_FORMAT) over sorted files+empty dirs with uid=gid=0, uname=gname='root', mtime=1793350920, mode 0755/0644, wrapped in gzip.GzipFile(filename='', mtime=0, compresslevel=9); writes the identical sha256 above

roundtrip_verification.extracted_to: a fresh mktemp scratch directory (not retained in the repo)

environment_contract.launch_cwd: the game-source directory (data/appearance.janet and data/materials.janet resolve relative to cwd)
environment_contract.env_scrub: all JANET_* and BENDER_* removed, then JANET_NO_PROFILE=1, JANET_LANES=0, XDG_CACHE_HOME=<per-arm cache>
environment_contract.writes_nothing: a bounded --frames run skips save-on-exit; the frozen tree is read-only input

verification_commands.note: Build a checkfile from either committed JSON manifest with: python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);sys.stdout.write("".join(e["sha256"]+"  "+e["path"]+"\n" for e in d))'

not_claimed: No game run, build, or benchmark was executed to produce this document.
No performance number is asserted; timing evidence is the parent's separate arm output.
An AOT binary built from these bytes is not evidence that native game kernels emitted.
The saved-world copy is byte-identical to the live original only as of the freeze.
